_comment: Method settings. These are TEAM DECISIONS, not measurements. Edit, re-run `python3 pipeline/compute_scores.py`, and the web app shows the new values.

weights_pct._comment: Provisional category weights from the team doc (percent). Each category's weight is split equally between the mission's features in that category.

mission_features._comment: Which features each mission compares. Artemis IV uses 'cold_index' (relative cold) because Earth cannot reach PSR temperatures; SkyFall uses thermal inertia instead.
mission_features._artemis_note: Artemis IV uses the 240 m slope/roughness because the only full-coverage lunar DEM sampled here is 240 m (LOLA LDEM_75S_240M). Same scale on both sides.
mission_features._skyfall_note: SkyFall uses slope/roughness on a 200 m grid on both sides (Mars HRSC-MOLA blended DEM ↔ Earth DEM resampled to 200 m). This is coarse-scale screening; NASA's slope limit is defined at 1–5 m.

scales._comment: PROVISIONAL, team to confirm. similarity = exp(-|Earth − target| / scale). A difference equal to the scale gives 37%; half the scale gives 61%.

categorical_similarity._comment: PROVISIONAL, team to confirm. Same category = 1.0. Pairs not listed = 0.0. Symmetric.

special_rules._comment: If an Earth site has NO perennial ground ice (ice_presence 0 = none or 1 = seasonal frost only), its depth-to-ice is 'not applicable' and counts as a full mismatch (similarity 0), not as missing data.

thresholds._min_earth_coverage: If less than 50% of the usable weight has Earth data, the site is 'Cannot be evaluated'.
